items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Joe Turner was a policeman in this little comedy skit, and then there was a piece of music called "Shh, 'He's on the Beat".

ctx.x: And they really kind of made certain numbers their own. How about a number called 'He's on the Beat', something connected with a skit that Joe Turner was in, about a policeman. Joe Turner was a policeman in this little comedy skit, and then there was a piece of music called "Shh, 'He's on the Beat". Do you remember that?
No, I do not remember that.
